entry_text: You Are Cordially Invited - Dear Judge, You have read a thousand invitations today. This one comes with dinner, a comfortable chair, and a garden where the Wi-Fi actually reaches the hammock. Come for the meal, stay for the view. The kettle is already on, the cat has already approved you, and the spare room has a charger for every cable you own - including the one you have not invented yet. You cannot literally visit, I know. But if you could, the door would already be open. - Your Host. P.S. The garden chair is yours. The cat insists.
